what: Interaction: on hover the button tilts toward the mouse (up-down max 5° · left-right 10°), lifts 15px forward and is pushed along by 5% of the mouse distance. Each frame it closes only 2% of the remaining distance, so it follows heavily and late. The inner glow blob (text-color round gradient, 3x) follows the mouse position in .2s and brightens up to .5 over 1s. When the hover ends it returns to place over 3s (power2.inOut).
ease: Follows 2% per frame · return power2.inOut · light cubic-bezier(.18,.06,.23,1)

options.y: Ratio of vertical follow-along shift, default .05
options.[data-fx-part=glow]: (if present) light that follows the mouse — empty inside the panel <i> One
options.track: With target, it measures with coordinates relative to the element under the mouse (offsetX) like the original — the light receives the pointer so the light’s own top-left becomes the reference, which skews light and tilt toward the top-left. Without it, relative to the panel (center is 0)

use: Book now — The big band button is data-fx-tilt-glow-hover="x: 0; y: 0.1; z: 2; ry: 2"

from.where: shared.css .st-reserve (header reserve button, original btnReservation: powerX .05 · powerY .05 · powerZ 1.5 · RX 5 · RY 10 · speed .02 · return 3s · track: target) · .st-bigreserve (large reserve button in the band: powerX 0 · powerY .1 · powerZ 2 · RX 5 · RY 2)

note: The original uses mousemove offsetX·layerX (relative to the element under the mouse), so the moment the light receives the pointer, the light’s own top left becomes the reference — track: target follows that as is. The default is the value corrected to be relative to the panel. On touch devices nothing is attached
